title: Sending plugin values to Nightscout via NFC scan
symptom: When scanning Libre via NFC without Blucon, xDrip sends to Nightscout the last 15 minutes of data calculated via Datricsae plugin, but historical data is calculated via xDrip standard algorithm, resulting in a jumpy Nightscout graph while xDrip on phone is fine.
cause: The issue is suspected to be in the data uploader and where it gets the values to send to Nightscout, as after NFC scan the 15 minutes are sent with Datricsae calibration and the rest without.
evidence_quote: I was looking at the sql table in the phone and it looks for me that after the NFC scan the 15 minutes are sended to NIghtscout with Datricsae calibration and the rest without.
